source_title: Migrate From Gumroad To Lemon Squeezy

snippets.snippet_text: "Lemon Squeezy provides everything Gumroad does with more features. From support for SaaS / software companies, sales tax compliance, integrated email marketing, and more. Unlike Gumroad, you don't have to create your own PayPal account."
